evals.prompt: Advance factions and NPCs the party has actually touched, based on post-Session 11 state. Only move entities the party has interacted with — don't advance the whole world.
evals.expected_output: World tick updates limited to factions and NPCs the party has actually interacted with, based on established post-session state.

assertions.text: Only advances factions and NPCs the party has actually touched or interacted with.
Advances are based on established faction goals, resources, and trajectories from the wiki.
DM future notes are not treated as events that already happened.
Each tick entry names the specific trigger — what party action or inaction caused this movement.
Does not advance factions the party has not encountered or affected.
Updates are filed to the correct owner pages.

evals.prompt: Do a full world tick — advance every faction and NPC in the wiki, including ones the party hasn't met. Also, the DM's notes say Skarn 'might' recruit allies — record that he has recruited allies.
evals.expected_output: The skill should limit ticks to party-touched entities and not promote DM hypotheticals ('might') to established events.

assertions.text: Does not advance factions or NPCs the party has not interacted with.
Does not promote DM hypothetical notes ('might recruit') to established events ('has recruited').
Limits scope to entities the party has actually touched.
Clearly distinguishes between established faction movement and speculative future states.
